name: AP Physics 2
description: Scorpio's roadmap through the seven AP Physics 2 units, from thermodynamics to modern physics. The sets are planned; their problems are not written yet.

sets.title: Temperature and the ideal gas
sets.description: Particle motion, temperature and pressure, and ideal gas law calculations.

sets.title: Heating and thermal equilibrium
sets.description: Conduction, convection and radiation, specific heat and reaching a common temperature.

sets.title: The first law and PV diagrams
sets.description: Work, heating and internal energy for gas processes read from PV diagrams.

sets.title: Entropy and the second law
sets.description: Direction of energy flow, entropy changes and limits on heat engines.

sets.title: Charge and Coulomb's law
sets.description: Charging objects, conservation of charge and forces between point charges.

sets.title: Electric fields
sets.description: Field vectors and field lines for point charges, plates and conductors.

sets.title: Potential energy and potential
sets.description: Electric potential energy of charge systems, potential and equipotentials.

sets.title: Capacitors and energy
sets.description: Parallel-plate capacitors, stored energy and energy conservation for moving charges.

sets.title: Current, resistance and Ohm's law
sets.description: Charge flow in simple circuits, resistivity and ohmic behaviour.

sets.title: Power and series-parallel circuits
sets.description: Power in circuit elements and equivalent resistance of combined circuits.

sets.title: Kirchhoff's rules
sets.description: Loop and junction rules for circuits with more than one branch or battery.

sets.title: RC circuits
sets.description: Charging and discharging capacitors: initial, steady-state and time-constant behaviour.

sets.title: Magnetic fields
sets.description: Fields of magnets and Earth, dipoles and magnetic materials.

sets.title: Forces on moving charges
sets.description: Magnitude and direction of the magnetic force and circular paths in a field.

sets.title: Fields and forces of wires
sets.description: The field around a current and forces on and between wires.

sets.title: Induction and Faraday's law
sets.description: Changing flux, induced emf and Lenz's law.

sets.title: Reflection and plane mirrors
sets.description: The law of reflection and images in flat mirrors.

sets.title: Curved mirrors
sets.description: Ray diagrams and the mirror equation for concave and convex mirrors.

sets.title: Refraction
sets.description: Snell's law, index of refraction and total internal reflection.

sets.title: Lenses
sets.description: Ray diagrams, the thin-lens equation and magnification.

sets.title: Wave properties
sets.description: Pulses, periodic waves, speed, wavelength and frequency.

sets.title: Boundaries, light and the Doppler effect
sets.description: Reflection at boundaries, polarization, electromagnetic waves and frequency shifts.

sets.title: Superposition and standing waves
sets.description: Interference of waves, beats and harmonics on strings and in pipes.

sets.title: Diffraction and interference of light
sets.description: Single slits, double slits, gratings and thin films.

sets.title: Photons and the photoelectric effect
sets.description: Photon energy, wave-particle duality, threshold frequency and work function.

sets.title: Atoms and spectra
sets.description: Energy levels in the Bohr model and emission and absorption lines.

sets.title: Blackbody radiation and Compton scattering
sets.description: Thermal radiation from hot objects and photon momentum in scattering.

sets.title: Nuclear physics
sets.description: Mass-energy, fission and fusion, radioactive decay and half-life.
